entities.summary: Nadine Joachim, b. Ziemer is a German Karateka and former Deutscher Karate Verband coach. She was a karate European champion and World Champion graduated with distinction from her training as a diploma trainer at the German Sport University Cologne. On 7 December 2006 she received from German Interior Minister Wolfgang Schäuble the Silberne Lorbeerblatt.
